ptLiteralVerse: E o homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher; ela concebeu e deu à luz Caim.
enLiteralVerse: And the man knew Eve his wife; she conceived and bore Cain.

literalTranslations.pt: O homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher, e ela gerou Caim.
literalTranslations.en: The man knew Eve his wife, and she bore Cain.

literalTranslations.pt: Adão conheceu Eva e ela, concebendo, deu à luz Caim.
literalTranslations.en: Adam knew Eve and she, having conceived, gave birth to Cain.

literalTranslations.pt: Adão conheceu sua esposa Eva, que concebeu e gerou Caim.
literalTranslations.en: Adam knew his wife Eve, who conceived and bore Cain.
